title: Perplexity launches a local-first agent for private files and long-running work
friendlyTitle: Perplexity brings an AI worker to your own computer
summary: Portable Computer runs Perplexity’s orchestrator, local search, tool routing, and Qwen-based models on an NVIDIA DGX Spark, with RTX PC support planned. Work stays on the device by default, while cloud research or frontier models require user-authorised escalation.
friendlySummary: Portable Computer can read files, search documents, and run jobs on a local NVIDIA computer. It asks before sending work to cloud services.
whyItMatters: Local execution offers a practical middle path for confidential code, contracts, and internal documents: keep sensitive processing nearby, but selectively use the web or larger models when necessary. The current hardware and subscription requirements make this an early-adopter product rather than a mass-market option.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Private files can stay on your machine, while you can still use online research when you choose.
